li.label: away from home
li.description: Sleeping rough again. It was starting to feel like home back there.

li.label: missing home
li.description: My own bed, a proper roof, food that isn't out of a pack.

li.label: homesick
li.description: I've been out here long enough to forget what the place smells like.

li.label: desperate to go home
li.description: I don't care what we came out here for any more. I want to go back.

li.label: home sweet home
li.description: Back through the gate at last. Everything aches and I don't mind a bit.

li.label: home sweet home
li.description: A long road, and the end of it looks exactly like I remembered.

li.label: home at long last
li.description: I stopped believing I'd see this place again somewhere out there. And here it is.

li.label: made it to where we were going
li.description: Whatever happens next, the walking part is done.

li.label: made it to where we were going
li.description: Days of it, and we actually arrived.

li.label: arrived after a long haul
li.description: Nobody said the journey would take that long. We're here regardless.

li.label: camped for a while
li.description: Not home, but a fire and a night off my feet will do.
